description: A six-item, five-point self-report scale adapted by Fabris et al.

description: A PreK–Grade 3 oral-language development model developed by the Sobrato Family Foundation for multilingual learners, including English learners with disabilities.
title: Sobrato Early Academic Language (SEAL) model

description: SAEBRS is a universal screening assessment for students’ social, academic, and emotional behavior risk, used by schools and districts to identify needs and guide mental-health supports.

description: A 27-item Rasch-validated, two-dimensional self-report instrument developed by Kreijns et al.

description: A dataset of recorded L2 English monologue responses collected through Simulated Oral Proficiency Interviews and scored with a CEFR-aligned SLTI rubric by expert raters.

description: A CS/STEAM curriculum pathway developed and implemented by South Fayette School District, with lesson plans organized around four interdisciplinary throughlines and adopted or adapted by other projects.
